fields.if: a channel attention module (se or eca) is added after the last norm of each bottleneck
fields.then: top-1 rises by about 0.5 to 1.0 points at almost no extra cost for eca and a few percent more parameters for se
fields.because: channel reweighting lets the high-level features suppress uninformative channels (SENet, ECA-Net)
fields.disproved_if: adding se or eca at the late stages leaves top-1 within the noise level or lowers it

fields.if: attention is inserted at the early stages (1-2) instead of the late stages
fields.scope: ResNet-style classification backbone with the same attention module
fields.then: the gain is smaller than with late-stage placement
fields.because: early features are generic edges and textures where channel selection carries little class information
fields.disproved_if: early placement beats late placement by more than the noise level

fields.if: the 3x3 convolutions are replaced by depthwise-separable convolutions
fields.scope: bottleneck blocks of a ResNet-50-size classifier
fields.then: parameters drop by roughly a quarter or more and top-1 falls by about 0.5 to 1.5 points
fields.because: depthwise convolutions remove cross-channel mixing inside the 3x3 stage and reduce capacity
fields.disproved_if: the depthwise variant matches the standard convolution within the noise level

fields.if: the 3x3 convolutions of the late stages use dilation 2
fields.scope: low-resolution inputs (32x32), late stages whose feature maps are 8x8 or smaller
fields.then: top-1 changes by less than the noise level
fields.because: at these resolutions a dilated kernel mostly samples padding and adds little useful context
fields.disproved_if: late-stage dilation changes top-1 by more than the noise level in either direction

fields.if: spatial attention (cbam or coordatt) is used instead of pure channel attention
fields.then: the result is no better than se or eca
fields.because: small feature maps leave little spatial structure for the extra spatial branch to exploit
fields.disproved_if: cbam or coordatt beats the better of se and eca by more than the noise level

fields.if: the pooled features of the last two stages are fused with learnable weights
fields.scope: classification neck replacing plain global average pooling
fields.then: top-1 rises slightly, by up to about 0.5 points
fields.because: stage-3 features add mid-level cues that the final stage may have discarded
fields.disproved_if: weighted fusion lowers top-1 by more than the noise level
